(243)༄༅/ /skyabs 'gro ni/bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis

tei:div.tei:p: skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo// chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig /sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas gyi go 'phang 'thob par bya// de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ /las bum gyi nang du pad nyi'i gdan la khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang nag khros pa'i nyams can/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbyug pa phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/ khro bo'i cha lugs can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ sum+bha ni bzla/ mthar/ khro bo'i dbang pos bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /zhes phrin las bcol lo// (244)
